Next.js club management system for TJ Sokol Svinov (Czech handball club). Stack: Next.js 16 App Router · TypeScript strict · Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth) · TanStack Query v5 · HeroUI v2 · Tailwind CSS v4 · Vitest.
UI language is **Czech** — all user-facing strings must be in Czech.
Skills in `.claude/skills/` (use without being asked when situation matches): `/new-entity` (add new DB table/data model/CRUD; do not scaffold manually; invoke skill); `/db-sync` (after DB migration or when TS types out of sync); `/new-migration` (create new table/column/function/view/RLS policy; invoke proactively); `/generate-barrels` (after adding/renaming/removing any hook/component/type/enum file; run before committing); `/review-pr` (code/PR review).
Every entity layout: `src/types/entities/{camelCase}/schema/{camelCase}Schema.ts` AUTO-GENERATED, do not edit manually; `data/{camelCase}.ts` domain types extending schema; `src/queries/{pluralCamel}/constants.ts` (DB_TABLE + ENTITY); `queries.ts` read fns (QueryContext pattern); `mutations.ts` write fns (QueryContext pattern); `index.ts` barrel. Hooks/layout: `src/hooks/entities/{kebab-case}/data/useFetch{Entity}s.ts` dataFetchHook factory; `state/use{Entity}.ts` CRUD hook factory; `sr
